product_one_liner.value: Luciq is a mobile-first observability platform that captures app-session signals and helps mobile engineering teams diagnose issues, prioritize fixes, and automate remediation and releases.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes mobile observability built for mobile and AI agents, including issue diagnosis and fix workflows.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page describes the plan and its pricing basis, even though it does not list numeric prices.

named_customers.notes: Customer examples and linked case studies identify each as a customer.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies San Francisco, CA as company headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Sources report that Instabug, now Luciq, was founded in 2012.

eng_blog.notes: The Engineering category includes multiple technical posts about ClickHouse/S3 infrastructure, AI and code, and agentic debugging workflows; a cited infrastructure post names an engineer author.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation portal contains multiple product and integration articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page was available, but the visible open-position list did not show an AI, ML, data-science, research, NLP, LLM, or computer-vision role.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed the public docs, FAQ, Trust Center, and AI/privacy documentation; these describe AI features and supported clients but do not state a model provider used by Luciq's product.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center specifies SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022.

last_funding.notes: The most recent reported round is the $46 million Series B announced in May 2022.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest reported funding round occurred in May 2022, outside the 18-month window before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current careers listing includes an Enterprise Account Executive opening.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable launch/news history reviewed did not show a dated product or major-feature launch in the six-month window; the identifiable company/product launch announcement is the Luciq rebrand in September 2025, before the window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Jim Douglas's CEO appointment was announced in February 2025, outside the 12-month window; no later C-level or VP change was found in the checked company profile.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable integrations page, careers listing, and docs did not identify a CRM or sales/marketing system used internally. Product integrations such as Jira and GitHub are not CRM-stack evidence.
